description: This header file defines the structure and class interfaces for a HDMI CEC (Consumer Electronics Control) plugin within the WPEFramework. It includes data structures for device information and the main plugin class 'HdmiCec', which manages HDMI CEC device communication, event handling, and plugin interface implementation.

classes.name: CECDeviceInfo
classes.description: A data structure representing HDMI CEC device information, including logical address, vendor ID, OSD name, and device info status, with methods to update and clear device data.

classes.name: HdmiCec
classes.description: Main plugin class managing HDMI CEC communication within WPEFramework, including device management, event handling, and plugin interface implementation.

methods.name: setEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to set the CEC enable status via JSON parameters.

methods.name: getEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to get the CEC enable status via JSON parameters.

methods.name: getCECAddressesWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to get current CEC addresses.

methods.name: sendMessageWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to send a CEC message via JSON parameters.

methods.name: getDeviceList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of connected CEC devices.

methods.name: getActiveSourceStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current active source status.
